summary: The `ServiceCode` is a data entity that represents codes related to service provisions, offering functionalities to retrieve descriptions and associated metadata for various service configurations.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service codes and their metadata related to the HSPnet framework's service offerings.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

properties.name: ShortName
properties.description: Short code name used for quick reference.

properties.name: SortOrder
properties.description: Order in which the codes are sorted.

properties.name: Notes
properties.description: Additional notes or comments on the service code.

properties.name: NameAlt
properties.description: Alternative language name for the service code.

business_rules.description: Uses alt-language data if running in alt language mode.
